answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40026 Country: India Title: Is it necessary to recite in salah Allahummaghfirli warhamni when the first sajdah had completed Question: Is it necessary to recite in salah Allahummaghfirli warhamni when the first sajdah had completed? Answer ID: 40026 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1112/1112/M=1433) It is not necessary to recite the said dua between the two sajdahs. Yes, in nafl salah or while offering salah individually it is better to recite it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
